Locations.Title: Iguana Egg
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Konpeki Plaza - Looted from behind a log inside the penthouse, only accessible during [The Heist](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606380).

After [Playing for Time](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431), you can place it in a bowl in V's apartment, where it will hatch into an adorable pet after 90 in-game days.

Locations.Title: Nibbles
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Megabuilding H10 - After completing [Playing for Time](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431), exit V's apartment and turn left. Follow the corridor around a corner to find the [feed teh cat](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926135) shard.

After reading it, if you have Cat Food in your inventory (which can be purchased from food vendors), you can put it in the bowl on the ground. Come back some time later to find & adopt a kitty cat.

Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Based on your V's lifepath.

**Nomad:**
- A Turbo-R V-Tech car model with the Bakkers patch on its hood.

**Streetkid:**
- A diorama of Night City, with Arasaka Tower as its centerpiece.

**Corpo:**
- An Arasaka neomilitaristic digital clock.

Locations.Title: Militech Chest
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Only available for Nomad V.**

As part of [The Pickup](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605044), follow these steps:
- Call Meredith
- Use the Nomad dialogue option in the meeting, then accept her offer
- Begin a shootout with Maelstrom *after* meeting DumDum
- Discover the mole by reading the incriminating message on a computer in the All Foods factory, near [The MaxTac Way, by Mathias Maddox](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932214) shard
- Mention it to Meredith after leaving the factory

The chest will appear in your apartment in Act 2.

Stare in the direction of the sun, and V should pass out. If not, you'll need to read the messages and files on the computer in a church near the [Protein Farm](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=927521) fast travel point first.

Locations.Title: The Nomad
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
_Starting job for the Nomad background._

[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605002)

_Yo, V, every story's gotta start somewhere, right? Even if it means that "somewhere" is in the middle of nowhere and the most nova place to hang is a dusty-ass fuel stop. You abandoned your nomad family to come find the dude who hired you, to smuggle something for him 'cross the border. This guy will change your life._

Locations.Title: The Rescue
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605030)

_Wakako Okada's got us a gig. Fixer got an SOS call from one of her clients, Sandra Dorsett. All signs point to her having been plucked off the street by scavengers. Motherfuckers are in the biz of carving people up and selling their implants on the black market. Think it's time we paid them a visit. Whaddaya say?_

**Tips:**
- General tip - you can enable photomode just before hitting the ground to negate all fall damage.

Locations.Title: Practice Makes Perfect
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Optional job; triggered by accepting the tutorial at the start of [The Rescue](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605002)

_Better to be prepared than dead. The street can be brutally unforgiving, so a quick brush-up on combat skills certainly couldn't hurt._

**Tips:**
- Only the first two parts of the tutorial are mandatory.
- The others cover stealth and melee combat - a good way to get early XP.

Locations.Title: The Ripperdoc
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605039) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605002)

_If you're on the hunt for chrome, you won't find a better ripper than Viktor. Well, all right, maybe you could, but you sure as hell can't afford them. Not like Vik can afford you, either, but you're lucky he's got a soft spot - says you've got a good heart, like him. But before we pay ol' Vik a visit, we gotta decide what comes next._

**Tips:**
- You can pay for the enhancements upfront with 21,000 Eurodollars, skipping [Paid in Full](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605040)

Locations.Title: The Ride
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605044) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605030)

_High risk, high reward - as Dexter DeShawn likes to say. First rule of The Afterlife. So this is it, V. Time to go in, grab the bull by the horns and make a name for ourselves. But first, let's hear what Dex DeShawn has to say._

Locations.Title: The Pickup
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605045) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605039)

_Know what I like about your run-of-the-mill gangoons? They know what they like. Cash, sex, power... maybe just the sight of their enemies' blood. Real rays of sunshine, they are. But these Maelstrom cabrones... shit, never can be sure. They look at you with those creepy-ass toaster faces and you can't get a read of 'em, got no clue what twisted thoughts are racin' through their processors. You ask me, that's why biz with Maelstrom never turns out pleasant. But... sometimes there's just no gettin' around it. Let's grab that spiderbot, yeah? Make Dex proud._

**Tips:**
- Nomad V can tell Jackie to tune up his bike with Technical Ability 7 or higher. This unlocks [a vehicle](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=927291) later in the game.
- Nomad V can unlock the unique [Militech Chest](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932035) decoration; see its pin for details. 
- Brick's cell can be opened with code 9691

_If you want to avoid a shootout:_
  - Do not call Meredith. Tell Jackie to sit down. Pay 10,000 Eurodollars. 
  - This unlocks [Maelstrom Heat](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606473), and the chance to loot an iconic weapon, [Doom Doom](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=934381), later.


_If you want a shootout with Militech:_
  - Call Meredith. Hack the shard to remove its malware. Tell Jackie to sit down. Pay with the harmless shard.


_If you want a shootout with Maelstrom:_
  - Just shoot one of them! Good luck!
- Pay with Militech's shard for an easier fight against Royce. Be sure to grab his unique weapon, [Chaos](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606472)

Locations.Title: The Information
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606380) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605044)

_Either Evelyn Parker's got the best intel in town, the biggest pile of scratch, or the brightest goddamn lucky star twinkling over her at night. Fuck, maybe she got all three. Still, good thing Dex sent you to that meet. You clean up better. Anyway, this goes down right, she'll be a nice new contact for us. And you know the deal – won't get anywhere without contacts in Night City. So don't fuck it up._

**Tips:**
- When scanning the penthouse's security, don't forget to check the ceiling.

Locations.Title: The Heist
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606430) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605045)

_There's only one door you gotta open in Night City. And that's the door to The Afterlife. Once you cross into that world, peeps'll step aside for you everywhere. Dex couldn't have chosen a better place to pregame before the heist, am I right? Afterlife's a sign for us._

**Tips:**
- Once inside the penthouse, be sure to grab [Kongou](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606414)
- Before leaving the penthouse, grab [Nehan](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606419) and [Satori](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606427)

Locations.Title: Love Like Fire
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606380)

_It often happens that our memories are superseded by people's stories. Someone presents us a beginning, middle and an end, and soon enough we start believing that we really were there – that WE did all those things. But who we are is built on the past, and the past is built on lies._

**Tips:**
- Have fun - the pistol's awesome!

Locations.Title: Playing for Time
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917786) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606430)

_Well, looks like we got ourselves into a real fix. No chance in hell I'm wriggling myself out of this one, but you're still alive. And as Misty says, "As long as you're alive, there's hope." Fate's given you a second chance, so use it – get back on your feet. Do that, and consider your best friend's last wish fulfilled._

**Tips:**
- Finish the quest ASAP to unlock more open-world activities.

Locations.Title: Automatic Love
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928058) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431)

_So you've decided to find the chick who put on this first-class shitshow. She had a job and you took it 'cause there was no one else to knock some sense into your gonk head. I'm here now, but so what? This search and rescue bullshit's a dead end, but that's not about to stop you. Maybe Evelyn will, who knows? Sure seems like she doesn't wanna be found._

**Tips:**
- Invest in Technical Ability and Body to open doors.
- Alternatively, knock out the Tyger Claw in the restroom for an access card.
- Complete the [Monster Hunt](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606169) gig for an edge in Woodman's interrogation.

Locations.Title: Ghost Town
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930416) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431)

_Wanna track down Hellman? Start at the Afterlife. Sure, the place has changed over the years, but one thing never will: you got a question you just can't shake, head to The Afterlife. Always someone there to whisper the answer in your ear... for the right price. And if that someone's Rogue – shit, I wouldn't miss this meet for the world._

**Tips:**
- You'll need 15,000 Eurodollars to pay Rogue.
- If you help Panam kill Nash:
  - You'll get his rifle, [Widow Maker](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930415) (but it can be obtained later in the game)
  - You'll have to buy the [Quartz "Bandit"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930423)
- If you do not help Panam kill Nash:
  - Rogue will give you the [Quartz "Bandit"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930423) for free
- Neither option has an impact on your standing with Panam or romance prospects.
- After this job, if you reach Street Cred lvl 40, a [Hidden Gem](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=929813) will spawn.

Locations.Title: Down on the Street
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932397) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431)

_If someone told me I'd be taking calls from Saburo Arasaka's fucking bodyguard, I'd have laughed in their face. And now we're supposed to meet with some Takemura? Hand over all our detes? I'm not even gonna pretend like this is a good idea. But fuck it - sometimes you just gotta go all in._

Locations.Title: Tapeworm
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933126) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933123)

_Plays out alongside Act 2's main jobs. Completing it marks the beginning of Act 3._

_Looks like "know thyself" has become a two-for-one deal. If it's true we're becoming one person, I suggest we keep an open dialogue. And by the way, I'd be happy to explain why the only shot you got to survive is to reach Mikoshi and stay in one piece along the way. You'd be doing me a huge favor. After all, if you're not good at following my instructions, I have to inherit whatever's left of you._

Locations.Title: The Space in Between
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928059) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917786)

_If I've learned one thing from joyhouses, it's to quit while the going's good. Stare at those fake smiles too long, and all you'll see is misery. As far as clubs go they're all pretty pathetic, but at least it's in their own way. You know the chances of finding Evelyn are close to zilch, right? Like that's gonna change your mind... Anyway, let's go pay a visit to this so-called Fingers. But if we don't find Parker, you owe me a drink._

**Tips:**
- Invest in Body to breeze past the thugs.
- Getting too violent with [Finn Gerstatt](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=891814) will lock you out of his services.
  - All Ripperdocs share the same inventory, however, so there's no real consequence.

Locations.Title: Disasterpiece
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928210) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928058)

_Every city's got its shady neighborhoods and "no-go" zones. Stepping into these areas in Night City is like wading into the abyss and feeling it stare back through your soul. Anyone with an ounce of sense avoids these haunts altogether. Your average gonk's usually seen limping out, bleeding from one or more places. And you, V? Just make sure you come out intact._

**Tips:**
- Invest in Body and Technical Ability to open doors
- Be sure to grab [Errata](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928207), it looks *awesome.*

Locations.Title: Double Life
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928222) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928059)

_There's nothing you can't take away from a person - you just gotta look hard enough. When all options are exhausted, you've still got a body that can be harvested, skills that can be put to good use... Oh, and let's not forget "dignity" - that's a classic. Hell, I'm starting to think I could've done worse than end up on this little Relic of yours._

**Tips:**
- Complete [Love Rollercoaster](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928212) before entering the apartment; it'll be unavailable afterwards.
- Scan the posters on the floor, and hologram above the altar to complete the braindance.

Locations.Title: M'ap Tann Pèlen
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931820) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928210)

_Well, we know the Voodoo Boys were behind all this, so that's one step forward. Problem is, now we have to reach them somehow - two steps back. There are a lot of things to be found in Pacifica, just usually not what you're looking for. Good news is you already got your fixer: a man without a face to help you find this fart in the wind. Sounds like a fun fuckin' delight._

**Tips:**
- Be sure to grab [Butcher's Cleaver](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931819), a unique Knife

Locations.Title: Lightning Breaks
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931596) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917787)

_Panam Palmer. Gotta say, I like her. Girl's got a pair - and clearly a plan, too. Let's see if it's enough to grab Hellman. Honestly, V, never thought I'd ride with the nomads again. I know, I know she left the Aldecaldos, but you can feel it too, can't you? Clan's in her blood and bones. In her heart. Don't think she'll let us down._

**Tips:**
- The next job begins immediately after this one.

Locations.Title: Life During Wartime
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917829) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930416)

_An AV full of corpo-rats drowned in the dust and sand - a beautiful sight. Sucks for the nomads though, especially Panam. Looks like our dame keeps losing everything she loves. Correction - almost everything. In other news, Hellman's surely shitting his pants knowing that the game's up. He's all yours. Just be careful - those Kang Tao pissheads won't be going down without a fight. Finally doing things my way: we grab that 'Saka son-of-a-bitch by his corposuit collar, leave a bloody trail of destruction in our wake. Toss in a swipe at Kang Tao, too. Look at you, V. Just might make something of you yet. Anyway, one thing's for sure - we're close. Sure hope Hellman spills what he's got. And that what he's got is answers._

**Tips:**
- Scan the crash site thoroughly and help rescue Mitch to unlock [I'll Fly Away](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931621) later.
- Use the computer on the side of the AV to disable the turret
- [The Wasteland](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931605) Cyberpsycho Sighting will appear after this job

Locations.Title: I Walk the Line
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931837) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928222)

_I'm sick of this Placide motherfucker as much as you, but at least the fog has lifted, the goal is clear. You find a netrunner in the GIM and the Voodoo goons will set up a meet-n-greet with their queen. Pros? Maybe I'll actually get to see a legit netrunner, 'cause it's sure starting to feel like an extinct species these days. Someone who's got the guts to square off against the Voodoos has given me some hope, at least. But the cons? Damn near any minute your brain could start dripping out your ears. Afraid we won't have time to make pilgrimages to the monuments of Pacifica's Golden Age._

**Tips:**
- Be sure to grab [Sasquatch's Hammer](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931831)

Locations.Title: Transmission
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931842) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931820)

_It actually fucking worked. Working with the Voodoo Boys, Brigitte... It leads us straight to Alt. Looks like your troubles are over, kid. Fixing your head is gonna be a walk in the park for Alt, that I guarantee. You just do what Brigitte says for now - I'll handle the rest._

Locations.Title: Never Fade Away
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917829) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931837)

_You get nightmares, don't you V? The stubborn kind that keep coming back, night after night, like they wanna make sure you never forget a single detail, sight or touch? The kind where you can barely breathe because you know what comes next?_

_You ever get those? I know you do. So here - welcome to mine._

Locations.Title: Dog Eat Dog
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
First job in the Phantom Liberty storyline.

[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933312)

_Wow, this story's got it all! An unknown number, a mysterious caller, a shady meet-n-greet in the middle of fuckin' nowhere... And they say I'm the one always divin' headfirst into trouble. But sure, if it's not a trap, it's a one-in-a-trillion chance. Next stop: Dogtown. Can't wait to see how this shit unfolds._

**Tips:**
- It's much easier to get around the parking garage with Double Jump cyberware + Air Dash unlocked.
- Don't miss the [Perk Shard](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933256)!

Locations.Title: Gimme Danger
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933108) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917829)

_Our crazed ronin shows no signs of slowing his roll. We barely get intel from Wakako about the parade and Takemura's already hatching some harebrained scheme in Japantown. He wants to meet at the market? Fine, let's parley, but you already know where I stand. Don't let him strong-arm you into anything. Who knows how many loose screws are bouncing around that skull at this point..._

Locations.Title: Play It Safe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933123) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932397)

_Since I obviously wasn't invited to Saburo Arasaka's funeral, I guess this sad little parade will have to do - I'm just missing confetti. But in all seriousness, Takemura must have a death wish. He's just gonna jump onto Hanako's platform? Be my fucking guest - we'll deal with the snipers. Meanwhile, keep an eye out for an escape route. This is gonna go all kinds of wrong - I can feel it._

**Tips:**
- Watch out for the occasional tripwire
- After the first sniper, take the elevator to the 21st floor to grab [Genjiroh](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933119)
- The third sniper is totally surrounded by mines
- Be sure to loot Oda to receive [Jinchu-maru](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933116)

Locations.Title: Search and Destroy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928057) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933108)

_Know what my downside is? No matter how much I might want to, I don't fucking make mistakes. Lo and behold! Our factory-reset ronin, hounded by every single Arasaka soldier in Night City for KIDNAPPING Saburo Arasaka's daughter. Kudos to him - I couldn't've fucked this plan up better myself. And after all this he STILL wants you to drop by? I don't know who's more whacked - him or us. Just remember to knock four times. His head, preferably - against a fucking table._

**Tips:**
- Knock four times!
- You can save Takemura - jump back up through the floors and kill the Arasaka soldiers pinning him down.

Locations.Title: Nocturne Op55N1
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928057)

The next job (and ending you get) is determined by your choice.
- [We Gotta Live Together](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933185) (Aldecaldos - requires completion of [Queen of the Highway](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931639))
- ??
- ??
- ??

_We both knew this time would come. If we don't think of something quick, you will die - and I'll go with you. It's time for our final meeting._

**Tips:**
- Meeting Hanako is the 'point of no return' for side jobs.
- Don't worry about taking a while to meet up; she's very patient.
- You'll have more endings to choose from if you complete certain side jobs.

Locations.Title: We Gotta Live Together
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933188) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933126)

_I was gonna say that this time you'd have to go it alone, but it looks like the Aldecaldos've got some fight in them after all. Wonder what you see in them: a partner? Friend? Family? Something tells me sooner or later you're gonna have to choose one of the above, especially if it's thanks to them you get into Mikoshi._

**Tips:**
- Complete Cassidy's shooting challenge to receive [Amnesty](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933186) - and save before you attempt it!

Locations.Title: Forward to Death
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933190) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933185)

_Last stop on the line. Little does the corp know that this train's not going back. It's a shame I won't be there with you, 'cuz it's looking to be one helluva ride. But hey, that's what family's for, right? Anyway, once you get to the Arasaka sublevels, that crater filled with chrome and concrete, just take a second to remember that Johnny was there. Then mow down anyone in your way and get to Mikoshi._

Locations.Title: Belly of the Beast
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933203) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933188)

_You're almost there, V. In the heart of fucking darkness. Can you feel it? You're so close to the moment of goddamn truth. And I'm right there with you. Still. Always. Even if I'm just a blacked-out passenger in the backseat. Whatever you do, do it for us. At the very least, that's what I'm fucking counting on._

**Tips:**
- Loot Adam Smasher after defeating him for the Access Card

Locations.Title: All Along the Watchtower
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
_Final job of the Aldecaldos ending_ 

[Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933190)

_So you decided to ditch the City of Dreams - start anew, start fresh. I went through a few fresh starts in my life, too. And you know what? Don't regret a damn thing. You won't either. Give my regards to the South. And when you hear Johnny's voice, go ahead and smile, but don't bother to answer. It'll just be a voice on the radio recorded long ago, a fading reproduction, a flickering memory. You'll be someone completely different. Take care, V._

Locations.Title: Hole in the Sky
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933316) | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=932383)

_Songbird. Real pretty handle for the lethal netjock who just blasted into the Relic from a hijacked plane. Which just crash landed in that dump called Dogtown. Go on li'l soldier, run along and rescue NUS President Rosalind Myers. Assumin' it's not too late. If I missed anything, it's 'cause I'm busy writin' all this shit down for posterity – I don't like our chances here one bit._

**Tips:**
- Don't go too far off track, or the job will fail and you'll be locked out of most of the DLC.

Locations.Title: Spider and the Fly
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Next | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933312)

_Ooph, rough landing for Rosalind Myers. Kurt Hansen almost wiped her... at least this time, "almost" was all we needed. Since our dear prez survived, better get her out, drop her off somewhere safe and regroup with Songbird. Fingers fuckin' crossed you get it done quick – bein' cut off's gettin' real old._

**Tips:**
- Bring some damn strong weapons.

Locations.Title: Lucretia My Reflection
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Next | [Previous](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933316)

_Ahhh, back to the land of the livin'... Shame Songbird was the price to pay. Think she really kicked the bucket? My gut tells me this fiasco's nothin' but a small setback, although my nose did catch the unmistakable whiff of a 'runner's deep-fried gray matter... Now all that's left is surviving NC's most twisted district while babysittin' Madam Prez herself... Shit, V, take on a simpler gig next time, would ya?_

**Tips:**
- Grab the [Chimera's core](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933326) for a cool apartment decoration!

Locations.Title: The Streetkid
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Starting job for the Streetkid background.

[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605002)

_Hows it feel bein' back home, V? C'mon, admit it - you missed Heywood. What, between all the dealers, hookers and total lack of opportunities, it's got its charm, don't it? You're born in Heywood, you die in Heywood. Unless you're one of the lucky ones, that is. What about you? That include you?_

_If there were an ad for Night City, it'd have Kirk's dumb, grinning face on it. He's slick, thinks he's smarter than he really is and is kind of an asshole, but whenever you call him, he's got the next Big Job that'll rake in millions - like stealing a car from a secure parking garage. 'Cause obviously the millionaires of the future are sitting in the Coyote Cojo scarfing down chili burgers... right?_

Locations.Title: The Corpo-Rat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Starting job for the Corpo background.

[Next](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605002)

_Sometimes I wonder what it's like to work for Arasaka, y'know? Way I figure it, it's like playin' Russian roulette for a million eddies. Give it a spin, pull the trigger. You hear it click, you strike it rich. And if you don't, well... the mess is someone else's problem._

_So to recap – Abernathy is Jenkins' boss, Jenkins is your boss and he ordered you to off Abernathy. It's a classic damned if you do, damned if you don't situation. You kill her – you're fucked. You tell Abernathy – you're even more fucked. Why? Because for the past few years you've been batting for Jenkins' team. If you get the job done, and do it well, you might get a promotion, but forget sleeping at night, because who knows how soon you'll be in someone's crosshairs. Only proves the wide variety of opportunities Arasaka has to offer._

Locations.Title: The Gig
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Call Wakako Okada at the end of [The Rescue](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605002)

- Tyger Claws Dermal Imprint from [Ripperdoc - Cassius Ryder](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605015)

Locations.Title: The Gift
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Head back to your apartment during [The Rescue](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605002)

**Tips:**
- Buggy - if a 'Quickhack Menu' tutorial pops up and won't go away, you'll need to complete this job.
- To reach the [Netrunner](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605275), look for stairs to the upper level of the large round building.

**Reward:**
- Ping mod

Locations.Title: Beat on the Brat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Talk to the Coach inside V's apartment building.

_You're gettin' noticed, V. People can sense that hunger in you – one that can't be satiated. You want everything right now, and if you don't do it... you fight for it. You're a warrior, V. And the warrior's place is in the ring. Show 'em what you're made of. Knock the bolts off this training bot. And then, well... we'll see._

**Tips:**
- The final fight is only available after completing [Transmission](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931837)

**Reward:**
- [Boxing Trophy](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931847) (if you win the final fight)

Locations.Title: The Gun
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Approach the Weapon Shop inside the apartment building.

_We've got this tradition in Heywood – on your sixteenth birthday your dad gives you a gun. I didn't get one, cuz I had a shitty dad. But you're way past your sixteenth, aren't ya? High time to get yourself a solid piece of iron._

**Reward:**
- [Dying Night](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605035)

Locations.Title: Paid in Full
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** During [The Ripperdoc](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605030), get the enhancements without paying upfront.

_I don't know many rippers who'd install Kiroshi optics on credit and faith. In fact, I only know one – Viktor. Maybe once you're on top you don't forget about the old guy, yeah? Pay the good doc his 21 thou._

**Tips:**
- Sell enemies' weapons and other junk you find at Drop Points

**Reward:**
- Victor's services can be used once again

Locations.Title: Psycho Killer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Exit the Ripperdoc's clinic as part of [The Ride](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605039)

_Ever heard of a fixer by the name of Regina Jones? Not exactly the same league as Dex, but she must've heard about you since she wants to turn you into a one-person army in the fight against cyberpsychosis. Understandable, seeing as most of our heroic badges seem to vanish from the scene at the mention of "cyberpsycho."_

_Do not fuck this up – one happy fixer will make three others interested in your services._

_I still don't get why Regina wants them alive, but I guess the higher you go, the weirder the contracts get. That's the Afterlife for you._

**Tips:**
- **Do not** kill the Cyberpsychos - use blunt melee weapons and non-lethal bullets
- Save before each encounter, just in case!
- Cyberpsychos are like boss fights - gear up for a good fight.
- [The Wasteland](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931605) will only appear after [Life During Wartime](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931596)

**Reward:**
- Pax mod
- Cyberware Capacity Shard
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Sacrum Profanum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Speak to Bhikkhu, and agree to help rescue his brother.

_Among the handful of things that really piss me off, I'd say pickin' on the little guy for funsies is pretty high on my list. If I could save this monk and scrap a few tinboy Maelstromers along the way, I'd say sign me up. If you feel the same – and hurry your ass up – maybe you can even still save the guy._

**Tips:**
- **This job is time sensitive, so act fast!**
- Bhikkhu doesn't want you to kill any of the Maelstromers.
- Fenrir is on a table near the captive Monk.

**Reward:**
- [Fenrir](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605347)
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Beat on the Brat: Kabuki
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Begin [Beat on the Brat](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605033) and approach this area.

_Don't overthink this one. You have to defeat the champion of Kabuki. You know the stakes, you know the place. Now get your ass over there and win._

**Tips:**
- Keep your guard up - it's a 2v1!
- Use heavy attacks to stun one twin, then get a few hits on the other.
- Alternatively, focus on beating the hell out of one twin to avoid having to fight them both at once for too long.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Burning Desire
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Approach the distressed man

_That's the great thing about Night City - no chance you'll ever get bored here. Where else could you have some dude with a smoking crotch jump into your car askin' to hitch a ride? Come on, V, show some sympathy. Get this guy to a ripper before his dick explodes all over your dashboard._

**Tips:**
- This job is time sensitive, so act fast - _and make a manual save before you get started._
- If you ignore the job, it will automatically fail.
- Try to buy a decent car before beginning.
- Drive fast, but not too fast - hitting any walls will cause the job to fail.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Human Nature
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [The Heist](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606380) and make significant progress through [Playing for Time](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431)

_When a person dies, the world keeps chugging along without skipping a beat. Eventually, all traces of that person fade into nothing. Long story short, that's why your wheels were towed. Want my opinion? The best way to convince the world you're alive and kicking is to get your wheels back. Hell, maybe it's not the most ambitious goal, but for a minor-league merc like you, at least it's a start._

**Tips:**
- You can buy another vehicle via Autofixer Terminals or the AUTOFIXER website, accessible via most computers.
- Repairs will only begin after completing [Playing for Time](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431)

**Reward:**
- Car Fixed

Locations.Title: Venus in Furs
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** During [The Pickup](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605044), call Meredith and accept her deal - then _do not_ hack the shard she gives you. When you meet the Maelstromers, pay with the Militech shard, and you'll receive this job some time after completing [Playing for Time](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431).

_Meredith Stout invited you over to her room at the No-Tell Motel? Shit, V, don't know whether to give you props or talk you out of it... Either way, you're telling me your secret for picking up corpo chicks._

**Reward:**
- [Sir John Phallustiff](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606475)

Locations.Title: Fool on the Hill
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Examine any Tarot Card after they begin appearing in Act 2.

_Maybe these strange images that you're seein' really do exist. Or maybe the biochip's already turned your brain into scop and salmon casserole. Whatever the case, spotting these symbols in unexpected places feels like a mystery beggin' to be solved. In your shoes, I'd have a word with Viktor or that chakra chick about these. Should interest at least one of 'em._

**Reward:**
- [Misty's Dreamcatcher](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=927849)

Locations.Title: Heroes
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** During [The Heist](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606380), deliver Jackie's body to his family - then call Mama Welles in Act 2.

_I don't usually give advice, but... fuck it, here goes. Don't make the same mistake I made - say goodbye to the people you love. You know what I mean, right? Jackie Welles was your best choom, and you don't find a lot of straight-up peeps like that in NC. Best thing you can is remember them. Oh, and one more thing. If anyone asks, I didn't just say all that to you. Got it?_

**Tips:**
- Scan the [Pin-Up Posters](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926160) to unlock them as a decoration.
- Padre is upstairs.

**Reward:**
- [Jackie's ARCH / Jackie's Tuned ARCH](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=927291)
  - Nomad V can get Jackie's Tuned ARCH if you spoke about the bike before [The Pickup](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605044), and chose the dialogue that required Technical Ability 7 or higher.
- [La Chingona Dorada x2](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926162)
  - On the shrine 24 hours after the job is completed
- [Pin-Up Posters](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926160)
  - If they're scanned in the garage.
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Shoot to Thrill
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Receive a call from Wilson at some point after [Playing for Time](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431)

_A shooting range competition? Ho-ho, wonder what fun prizes are up for grabs. Giant teddy bear? Inflatable sword? Tiny plastic football? Whatever it is, enjoy yourself, 'cause I'm sittin' this one out. Don't much like it when people treat weapons like toys._

**Tips:**
- Save before starting the competition - an iconic weapon is up for grabs!
- Grab the [Morgan Blackhand – Street Iron](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926131) shard; it's only available here.
- Rapid-fire pistols, like [Dying Night](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605035), get more points.
- Score 40 points or more to win the competition.

**Reward:**
- [Lexington x-MOD2](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917839) + 1500 Eurodollars (if in first place)
- XP
- Street Cred
- 500 Eurodollars (if in second place)

Locations.Title: Happy Together
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Watch the cops knocking on a door one floor below V's apartment in Megabuilding H10. Only available in Act 2 onwards.

_Seems like the PD's taken an interest in a neighbor of yours. Even sounded like they knew each other. Will you assume the mantle of a concerned, responsible citizen and ask what's going on? I mean, if you got a potential psycho for a neighbor, wouldn't you want to know?_

**Tips:**
- For the best outcome, get ready for a long drive to the [Columbarium](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926508).

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: The Ballad of Buck Ravers
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Approach the guitarist.

_Don't think I've gone all sentimental or anything. Honestly, I couldn't give a shit if I've got any fans left in this city. If someone hears one of my tracks and they get the itch to take to the streets, then that's fucking nova, but those old recordings don't matter anymore. Find 'em, listen to 'em, I don't care. Although while we're on the subject... Wonder how things are over at Rainbow Cadenza..._

**Reward:**
- None

Locations.Title: Stadium Love
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Approach the area.

_Hey, if you wanna crash that party, I can respect that. Sometimes those parties kick the most ass. Just watch yourself - this ain't your uncle's birthday barbecue. One wrong word, one false step... there could be blood._

**Tips:**
- Save before the competition starts.
- Be ready for a bloodbath if you completed [Life's Work](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928806) violently
- Wait for the drunkenness to wear off between targets for an easier time; keep track of it via the bottle icon next to your health bar.

**Reward:**
- [Divided We Stand](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=927997) (if you got a score of 44 or higher)

Locations.Title: Dressed to Kill
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Approach the massacre.

_A photo shoot in Wraith territory? Respect. Nothing sells like a good 'n' gory firefight. Man, if you'd seen our ultra underground word-of-mouth gigs... Anyway, looks like they were trying to sell some fucking overpriced sadrags, but at least some choom had the corpoballs to drag 'em all out here in that sweet, sweet ride._

**Reward:**
- [Thorton Colby CX410 "Gran Butte"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926807)

Locations.Title: Space Oddity
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Approach the bums.

_Every bum in this town dreams someday they'll hit the jackpot on something they dug up in a dumpster and it'll transform their life. A briefcase stuffed with eddies, a shard holding big company secrets, a cuttin' edge implant that'll pawn for a few dozen Gs. Problem is, usually whoever "misplaced" the thing to begin with is still lookin' for it - and they ain't in a good mood. Do these poor street rats a favor and take this case off their hands. Before the previous owner shows up and decides to make target practice out of 'em._

**Tips:**
- A Body check or 2000 Eurodollars are needed to get the briefcase peacefully.
- The briefcase can be hacked with an Intelligence check
- Be ready for a fight at the drop point

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- [Untitled 18 – Brancesi, 2021](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=927494)

Locations.Title: Raymond Chandler Evening
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Enter [El Coyote Cojo](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926161) and witness the Valentinos harassing the man.

_Usually it's the customers spilin' the ugly personal stories to the bartender, yet there we were, seeing it the other way around. Pepe thinks his wife is cheating on him and he's looking for someone to confirm his worst suspicions. Classic. A cuckold, a beautiful woman, a city shrouded in darkness... Get the feeling I've read this story before._

**Tips:**
- This job is time sensitive, so act fast - _and make a manual save before you get started._
- For the best outcome:
  - Save the drunk man from a beatdown
  - Agree to Pepe's request
  - Scan Cynthia, and follow her at a distance of around 20m to avoid detection
  - Tell Cynthia that her husband sent her.
  - Call Pepe, and tell him the truth - then tell him that 'She loves you, you gonk.'

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Beat on the Brat: Arroyo
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Begin [Beat on the Brat](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605033) and approach this area.

_Heard somewhere the champ of Arroyo is a grade-A prick. Good news - should make beatin' his ass all the more fun._

**Tips:**
- Bring 18,000 eddies and pass a Body check to comment on his rifle; he'll bet it.
- If you win, he (and his pals) will turn hostile, so be ready!
- You can also kill him after a regular buy-in to get the weapon.

**Reward:**
- Eurodollars
- [O'Five](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=927999)

Locations.Title: Beat on the Brat: Rancho Coronado
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Begin [Beat on the Brat](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605033) and enter the warehouse.

_A fight in an Animals' club? Oof... feel sorry for you, I do. These guys play hard, V. It won't be easy... and it won't be fun._

**Tips:**
- If you're struggling, consider Gorilla Arms cyberware to pack a heavier punch.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Access to [Melee Weapon Vendor](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605779)

Locations.Title: Beat on the Brat: The Glen
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Begin [Beat on the Brat](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605033) and approach the area.

_Time for another rumble - this time in the Glen. I'd put money on their champ being a Valentino. Yeah, I can see him now: two golden fists and a machete across his back... y'know, in case things get dicey and take a turn for the unsportsmanlike._

**Tips:**
- If you're struggling, consider Gorilla Arms cyberware to pack a heavier punch.

**Reward:**
- Eurodollars
- [Alvardo V4FC 580 "Vato"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928004)

Locations.Title: Every Grain of Sand
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete all of [Dakota Smith](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926526)'s gigs.

_Dakota's a good sport. She believes decent work deserves a decent pay, and that is exactly what you will get from her._

**Reward:**
- [Mackinaw "Saguaro"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928021)

Locations.Title: Tune Up
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Get into your vehicle as part of [Human Nature](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606433), and open the text from Delamain.

_Fender benders are a dime a dozen in Night City. A Delamain though? A first, I'm guessing. But now he wants to hand out compensation for damages? That's just downright suspect. Way I see it, he's got a the AI equivalent of a gun pointed at his head, and this message is nothing but a coded cry for help. Nobody, and I mean nobody, doles out compensation for a little chipped paintwork. Go and see what this is about - worst case you come out a little richer._

**Reward:**
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Epistrophy
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [Tuned Up](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928022)

_Cars didn't talk back in my day, and now this one wants to give you a job? What a time to be alive... What're you waiting for?_

**Reward:**
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Epistrophy: North Oak
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Begin [Epistrophy](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928023) and approach the area.

_A taxi in distress calls for a hero like you, V. If you want to become a legend, set out on this quest for ultimate glory. The Afterlife awaits!_

**Tips:**
- Drive slowly (under 60mph); damaging the vehicle too much will fail the quest.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Epistrophy: The Glen
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Begin [Epistrophy](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928023) and approach the area.

_Ahh, the Glen. You know this used to be a college campus? Some thought that taking out colossal loans and enrolling in a biotech degree would make their lives better. Then the harsh reality kicked in - it was easier to throw yourself off a bridge than get into a corporate research lab. Makes you wonder why our rogue Delamain cab chose this place of all places._

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Epistrophy: Coastview
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Begin [Epistrophy](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928023) and approach the area.

_Ever been to Coastview? Not too shabby. Had an output from there once. Sure, maybe she liked to wheeze, jab, pop and snort a little too much, but who wasn't in those days? Her name was Amanda or Amelie or something, I don't remember. Remind me to tell you the shooting range story sometime._

**Tips:**
- Be ready for a fight!
- [The cake is a lie!](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928033)

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Epistrophy: Wellsprings
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Begin [Epistrophy](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928023) and enter the area.

_Head to Wellsprings to find one of Delamain's missing vehicles. Or go save yourself from impending death. Up to you._

**Tips:**
- Be ready for a wanted level if you choose to shoot the car.
- Bring a weapon that's not _too_ destructive.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Epistrophy: Rancho Coronado
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Begin [Epistrophy](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928023) and approach the area.

_Never been a fan of Rancho Coronado, personally. If you really gotta find a cab out there, just do it quick and get back into the city, OK?_

**Tips:**
- Watch out for 6th Street gonks while smashing the flamingos

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Epistrophy: Badlands
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Begin [Epistrophy](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928023) and approach the area.

_Over the mountains, through the woods, nestled on the hills beyond North Oak - that's where your pal Delamain lost one of his cabs. He's a goddamn talking car himself and, apparently, has more cars of his own. I dunno, but I just say we continue this little fairy tale, find that cab, save the princess and claim half the kingdom._

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Epistrophy: Northside
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Begin [Epistrophy](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928023) and approach the area.

_I kinda like this Delamain. He's comfortable in his own code, not ashamed to be a talking car. He's asked you to find one of his rides in Northside, so I say we do him a favor._

**Tips:**
- Consider bringing a motorbike for an easier chase.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: I'm in Love with My Car
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Enter the warehouse some time after completing [Playing for Time](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606431).

_Ain't you a little old to be dreamin' about a pro racing career? Still... be a damn shame to let a preem set of wheels like this go to waste. Just let the mayor know if you wanna shut down any city streets. Or don't – fuck that guy._

**Tips:**
- Loot a box beneath the collapsed shelves behind the car to find the keys.

**Reward:**
- [Type-66 "Hoon"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928039)

Locations.Title: Love Rollercoaster
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Approach the group any time *before* completing [Double Life](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928210)

_And they say Pacificans don't like strangers... These kids must be an exception to the rule. They found themselves a good vantage point and it'd only be better if that got that old roller coaster runnin'. At least, that's what I'd try._

**Tips:**
- The job will disappear after [Double Life](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928210)
- Put your arms up and go "AAaaaah!"

**Reward:**
- Rollercoaster ride! Wheeeee!

Locations.Title: Don't Lose your Mind
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Receive a call from Delamain some time after completing [Epistrophy](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928023)

_Your buddy Delamain appears to be having some personal issues. How else do you explain his cabs standing in the middle of the road and blocking traffic? better give him a call. Besides, you're short on friends (present imaginary company excluded)._

**Tips:**
- The locked computer's password is 1234.
- For the best (?) outcome, you'll need an Intelligence of 20.

**Reward:**
- [Delamain No. 21](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930472)

Locations.Title: The Beast in Me
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [Double Life](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928210) and respond positively to the text from Claire.

_No one in Night City is only one layer deep. Take Claire for example - an Afterlife bartender who likes to burn rubber in illegal street races when she's on break. If you get the itch for a little adrenaline, I think you can scratch it at her garage._

**Tips:**
- Be sure to pick specific dialogue options and texts during / after [The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931626) for the best ending.
- After following Sampson off the road during [The Beast in Me: The Big Race](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931640), choose these dialogue options for the most rewards:
  - What's he mean?
  - Wait, wanna hear this.
  - Claire, that true?
  - Yeah. Let him go.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars
- [Mackinaw "Beast"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931643)
- [Type-66 “Cthulhu”](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931852) - only if Sampson was spared, and after a week or two passes.

Locations.Title: A Day In The Life
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Speak to the vendor, and agree to help him out.

_Gonna sound like my gramps for a sec, but you know, in my time, being a punk meant something different. People fought against the system whatever way they could, frying the biggest fish they could catch, tearing down palaces brick by brick. Now every random gonk-brain fool thinks they're a hero for flatlining an unarmed normie. This isn't your beef, I get it... But are you sure don't wanna teach those worms a lesson?_

**Tips:**
- With a high enough Street Cred, standing up for the vendor will have a quick and easy resolution.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars
- [Food Vendor](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928573) unlocked

Locations.Title: Over the Edge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Play the braindance in the trash can next to the Edgerunners graffiti.

_Someone sprinklin' XBDs around the city with cyberpsychos in the leading roles? The fuck's that about? And that warning at the end... Strangest fuckin' PSA I've ever seen. Only thread to follow here is the name dropped at the end – David Martinez. Sounds like the headstrong type. I like him already._

**Reward:**
- [David's Jacket](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928813)

Locations.Title: Ezekiel Saw the Wheel
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Order something from the diner's owner.

_Here's a joke for you: V walks into a bar... and gets robbed. The end._

_Jesus, you and your shit luck. You better figure something out quick or our epic story's about to get cut short in the stupidest way imaginable. Accidental deaths don't jive too well with me. Or with the birth of legends._

**Tips:**
- Invest in Body for a quick and easy resolution.
- If things get violent, use non-lethal weapons to keep the owner happy.

**Reward:**
- Free items from the [Food Vendor](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928591)

Locations.Title: Imagine
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Approach the monk on the bench.

_In Night City, there's no shortage of gonks, hustlers and just plain assholes. And if you stopped to talk to each one, you might just cross the last of your wires, too. But if that's what your gut's tellin' you to do, by all means. Just watch for sticky fingers._

**Reward:**
- None

Locations.Title: Sex on Wheels
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [Life's Work](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928806) and let some time pass.

_Who ever said no to a free car? Not to mention it's a Quadra Turbo Fuckin' R. So quit picking your nose, head down to Rancho Coronado and get behind that wheel._

**Reward:**
- [Turbo-R V-Tech](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928812)

Locations.Title: Big in Japan
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Speak to Dennis, found near Rogue in the [Afterlife](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606382) during Chapter 2 onwards.

_Find the package, and deliver it from A to B. Simple job, huh? But then why not just book some delivery guy? And why not go through a fixer? Something smells off about this one, V._

**Tips:**
- Save right after opening the fridge - if the man is killed, the job will fail.

**Reward:**
- Eurodollars
- [Scalpel](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928872)

Locations.Title: Only Pain
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Intervene in the beating.

_"To serve and protect..." Funny, would've thought "To extort and torture" might fit better. Not sure what this guy's beef is with badges, but if you don't step in, they'll be scrapin' him off the sidewalk. Once they smear him there first, of course. But I dunno... maybe it's for the best? After all, no one's in Night City's dyin' an innocent soul._

**Tips:**
- Streetkid V can learn more about the situation from the cops.
- Use Reflexes or Cool to unlock more dialogue with the corpo.
- If you get information first, you'll need 15 Cool for a cash reward.

**Reward:**
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Full Disclosure
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Unlock Tier 5 gigs from [Regina Jones](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605056), and receive a text from Sandra Dorset.

_Sandra Dorsett... that chick you pulled out of a scavs' nest? Man, give someone an inch and they take a mile... This databank must be pretty special to her if she ain't even willing to go through a fixer. Well, damn... now I'm kinda curious. Gonna help out - or play by the rules of the game?_

**Tips:**
- You'll find the databank at the [Last Login](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928878) gig location.
- For the highest payout, hack the shard, then use these dialogue options:
  - Yes, I did.
  - I wanna congratulate you.
  - (Intelligence 15) What daemons did you use?

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: The Prophet's Song
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Listen to Gary the Prophet's preachings whenever a 'side job' icon appears in this area. In Act 2, his rant about Nomads will trigger the job.

_A clandestine meeting of reptilians at midnight? V, we're not missing this. If you want answers to the questions plaguing humankind for eons, this might be your only shot. Is there life in the cosmos? Is there anyone pulling the strings? If so, why? And why the fuck do they let all this evil shit happen? And to think the Universe's greatest secrets could be found in some old factory in our humble little Night City..._

**Tips:**
- Be careful if visiting Misty; the Nomads can appear and fight Garry, failing the job without your knowledge.
- If you've completed [Queen of the Highway](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931639) or are Nomad V, the Nomad situation can be handled peacefully.
- Kill the Corpos / Maelstromers at the meeting, or the job will fail.

**Reward:**
- [Destroy After Reading](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605768)

Locations.Title: Machine Gun
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Pick up [Skippy](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=929745#L), found near a body in an alley, and kill / maim 50 enemies. After Skippy comments on your body count, wait a few more days for the gun to ask to be returned to Regina.

_So, what, You're giving Skippy to Regina? Too bad. Not everyday find a gun you can share your deepest and darkest with. And have it reciprocate, that is. On the other hand, I get you... Already got enough voices in your head, amirite?_

**Tips:**
- Bum bum be-dum bum bum de-bum bum

**Reward:**
- XP
- Eurodollars
- Skippy (without AI) after a few days have passed, once Regina sends a text.

Locations.Title: Last Call
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete all of [Regina Jones](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605056)'s  gigs.

_Finally. No more calls, no more Watson gigs. That's great. Has anything changed? Not really, if you ask me. Watson's like a feral dog – many have tried to tame and treat it, but all they got is scars and a few bad memories. You went into dark alleys, clashed with some gangoons, got shot at a few times and for what? All you did is diluted the shit that's covering this entire neighborhood. You know that as well as Regina does. Nothing ever changes here. But hey, at least you tried, right? You completed all the assignments – let's celebrate a bit! And Regina won't let you leave empty-handed. Something to remember her by._

**Reward:**
- [Axolotl](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=929934)

Locations.Title: Gas Gas Gas
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete all of [Dino Dinovic](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926225)'s gigs.

_Dino may be a poser, but I feel we could still become friends. He's a sex, drugs & rock 'n' roll kinda guy – preem choom material. Anyway, you managed to complete all of his assignments, so he wants to repay you in kind. Bastard's simply impossible to dislike._

**Reward:**
- [Type-66 "Bulitt"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930085)

Locations.Title: Professional Widow
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete all of [Wakako Okada](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=891818)'s gigs.

_The Westbrook gigs are all done and dusted. Wakako said she has something for you – wonder what it is? Another thinly veiled ex-husband threat-story, or something you can actually use? Guess we'll find out soon enough._

**Reward:**
- [Byakko](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930116)

Locations.Title: These Boots are Made for Walkin'
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
*Nomad V Only*

**How to Start:** - Receive a text after the second meeting with Rogue as part of [Ghost Town](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917787)

_Here you thought your old ride was totaled for good - yet here you are now. Like a phoenix from the ashes, it lives again. But how? Why now? You'd already closed that chapter of kickin' up sand with nomads out in the desert... But I mean, it'd be stupid if you didn't check it out... right? You never can underestimate the past. Because it sure as shit likes to take revenge._

**Reward:**
- [Galena "Rattler"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930382)

Locations.Title: Murk Man Returns Again Once More Forever
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Approach a shipping container on your left if traversing the tunnel from the south. It will only appear after completing [Ghost Town](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917787) (regardless of the choices taken), and reaching Street Cred level 40.

_Shit, V. Even the two of us put together aren't as fucked in the head as this guy. Sorry, MAN. I mean, fuck the cave shit, just look at those manifestos on justice in this town. Choom really thinks Night City can be saved. Still, whatever our murky friend's missing in the sanity department, he makes up for with his excellent taste in fine automobiles. And hey - he's not the only one who loves a good ride, am I right?_

**Reward:**
- [Caliburn "Murkmobile"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930420)

Locations.Title: Quartz "Bandit"
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [Ghost Town](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917787) by refusing to help Panam kill Nash.

_One last thing, V. I know how to reward professionalism, loyalty - traits that a certain someone evidently  lacked. That reward's called a Quartz Bandit and it now belongs to you. Sending you the coords..._

**Reward:**
- [Quartz "Bandit"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930423)

Locations.Title: Ride Captain Ride
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete all of [Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926740)'s gigs.

_Phew. Glad to hear your business in Santo Domingo is finally over. You did what you could – the junkies will keep shooting up, the 6th Street pricks will wave their flags, and all the young punks growing up there will go down one of those two paths. But you've changed the place for the better, if only slightly. Cast a ray of sunlight into a godforsaken cesspit, so to speak. Helping El Capitan was the right call – he gained more control over Santo Domingo, and now he wants to throw in something extra for your efforts digging through all the waste. Guy knows how to reward his flunkies, that's for sure._

**Reward:**
- [Bloody Maria](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930469)

Locations.Title: God Bless This Mess
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete all of [Sebastian Ibarra](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=926177)'s gigs.

_So the Saint of Heywood recognized the deeds of his unholy servant? That's lovely. Gotta admit, his sanctimonious attitude in the light of the increasing bodycount was getting on my nerve. The man's the walking definition of hypocrisy. Anyway, that's all over and Padre has a gift for you. Maybe chasing Heywood thugs was actually worth something after all?_

**Reward:**
- [Seraph](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930470)

Locations.Title: KOLD MIRAGE
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Read the [Notice of Expiration](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=605660) shard to have it begin after making progress in [Ghost Town](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917787), or complete [Spellbound](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933172)

_Always somethin' interesting to be found at the dump. Take a half-dead, half-brain merc with an experimental chip in their head for example. Or, in this case, a freezer from 2020... a glimpse into the past._

**Reward:**
- Quickhack x5

Locations.Title: Bullets
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Visit [Jinguji](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=927181); the job will appear a few days later.

_Looks like there's some justice in the world after all. My little merc wants to play dress-up like a corpo, then all the sudden a cyberpsycho kicks down the shop's door. Coincidence? Sure, probably, but a fuckin' delightful one. I hope you learn a valuable lesson today. That is, if you survive 'til the end of it._

**Tips:**
- Be ready for a Cyberpyscho fight!
- If you have Phantom Liberty installed, take down Melissa Rory (easiest by taking one step outside the store, re-entering, then crouching behind her) for a chance to loot her MaxTac Mantis Blades.
  - Some players report it only dropping after a non-lethal takedown.
  - Either way, save the game before you try it - MaxTac is no joke! 

**Reward:**
- None

Locations.Title: Stairway to Heaven
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [Imagine](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928810) and approach the monk.

_Look at that, your Zen master has reappeared. Some advertising shtick, no doubt. Thing is, I don't know fuck all about what he's trying to sell you. Stay sharp around characters like him._

**Reward:**
- None

Locations.Title: Poem Of The Atoms
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [Stairway to Heaven](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930679)

_You really enjoy this meditation thing? Calms your nerves, does it? 'Cause it somehow reminds me of those black-tie musicians they stick next to the towels and mouthwash in monochromer joints so you can get taste of culture after you let out a shit. But hey, to each their own._

**Reward:**
- None

Locations.Title: Meetings Along The Edge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [Poem Of The Atoms](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930680)

_Ok, this Zen master guy of yours is literally everywhere. He's gonna fall ass first out of your fridge tomorrow. This meditation's doing the trick for you? Listen, if it's the whole poetic aspect of it, I understand. But in that case just throw on one of my albums, dig into the lyrics, and leave this scam artist out of it._

**Reward:**
- [Zen Master's Altar](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930687)

Locations.Title: The Beast in Me: City Center
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Progress [The Beast in Me](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928227) and receive a text from Claire some time later.

_It's time to find out what really revs Claire's engine, huh? First face of the circuit takes you through the heart of Night City. Back in my time, people who won races like this could count on free drinks for a lifetime. So, y'know... not real long. But still._

**Tips:**
- Save before the race in case of shenanigans
- Buy a weaponised vehicle from AUTOFIXER and use it for an easier time

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: I Can See Clearly Now
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Approach the vending machine, and after a brief chat, ask if it wanted anything.

**Reward:**
- None

Locations.Title: Spray Paint
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [I Can See Clearly Now](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931595) and return when the side job icon pops up, twice.

**Reward:**
- None

Locations.Title: The Beast in Me: Badlands
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [The Beast in Me: City Center](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930690) and receive a text from Claire some time later.

_So, you're waiting for a date with Claire and her turbo-charged pet, Beast, away from all the city's hustle and bustle. I wonder how many bodies have been left to the bake in the Badlands sun after these races? Just do a me a favor and don't become one. Watch out for tumbleweeds, bumpy patches... armored Wraith trucks... Y'know, the usual._

**Tips:**
- Save before the race, just in case of shenanigans.
- You can only use Claire's car.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Riders on the Storm
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Receive a text from Panam some time after [Life During Wartime](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931596), and agree to help.

_OK, this must actually be pretty serious. Tough chick like Panam wouldn't call you up for some chump chore. Must be something important. Wouldn't waste any time on this one if I were you. To the Aldecaldos' camp we go._

**Tips:**
- Leaving the area after starting the job will cause it to fail
- Be sure to grab [Problem Solver](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931609)

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: I'll Fly Away
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** As part of [Life During Wartime](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931596), help Panam rescue Mitch. The job will appear here some time later, or be activated when Mitch gets in contact.

_Something about corpses draws you to their unfinished biz, V. First, it was me... now Scorpion. Mitch wants you to fulfill his final request. Gotta admit it's got my curiosity piqued, but hey, as a dead guy, I'm biased._

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- [Action Figure](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931623)
- [Stinger](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931624)

Locations.Title: Gun Music
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Approach the area after completing [Riders on the Storm](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931608)

_The Aldecaldos must really be desperate. To come this close to the city, and deal with scavs no less... Risky move. Sounds like they could use a hand._

**Tips:**
- Invest in Body for a peaceful resolution.


**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred

Locations.Title: The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Receive a text from Claire some time after [The Beast in Me: Badlands](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931604)

_Ah, Santo Domingo! The eternal fountain of shit where the only sure thing was you'd eventually step on the toes of some hot-blooded jarhead with "6th Street" tatooed on his ass. You win this race, V, you show them who's in charge around here. You got a good shot too – I don't see this Claire slowing down until she reaches the finals._

**Tips:**
- Save before the race in case of shenanigans
- Buy a weaponised vehicle from AUTOFIXER and use it for an easier time
- For the best outcome to the questline, use these dialogue options after the race:
  - Your driver, yeah.
  - Why tell me about him?
  - What's the connection to our race?
  - What happened to your husband exactly?
  - Tell me about this corpo Sampson?
  - **You sure it was murder?**
  - Want my help to kill Sampson?
  - **My priority's winning.**
- When she texts you afterwards, choose 'Don't worry about it. Just remember what you promised me.'

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Both Sides, Now
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Receive a call from Judy some time after calling Mr Hands as part of [M'ap Tann Pèlen](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928222)

_You ever hear the saying "No good deed goes unpunished"? You hold your hand out to someone, you get bitten. You help a poor soul in need, you get fleeced for all you're worth. Save someone's life? Fill in the blank._

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred

Locations.Title: With a Little Help from My Friends
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Receive a call from Panam some time after [Riders on the Storm](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931608)

_The great nomad saga continues: Panam's up to something. That girl just doesn't know when to quit - and my God, I love her for it. You don't seem to know either, considering you wanna go back out there. Maybe you could save us all some time, pitch a tent out in the desert? Think we both know this isn't just about the job anymore._

**Tips:**
- You can speak to Saul - sitting near the mission's starting point - and rat out Panam to receive [Mizutani Shion "Bonewrecker"](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931636)
  - This locks you out of one of the game's endings, and any further romance / jobs with Panam.
- During the tower conversation, avoid saying that you're 'not doing this for free', or you'll be locked out of romance.

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred
- Eurodollars

Locations.Title: Queen of the Highway
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [With a Little Help from My Friends](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931629)

_Once you finally hit it big, always turns out you fucked something else up - Night City's golden rule. Panam got her Basilisk all right, but Saul's sure to toss her out before she even gets a chance to enjoy it. If you really like this girl, now's a good time to have her back._

**Tips:**
- [Widow Maker](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=930415) is up for grabs if Nash wasn't killed during [Ghost Town](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=917787)

**Reward:**
- XP
- Street Cred

Locations.Title: The Beast in Me: The Big Race
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Start:** Complete [The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=931626) and receive a text from Claire some time later.
